items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible internal/read-only work. Recommendation: keep the private gate, leave Woot rights outreach unsent, and require human counsel review before any public display, affiliate, advertising, alert expansion, or upstream-data redistribution. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution rights; public terms restrict commercial/public use and derivative product-listing use. Security is evidence_needed because fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and owner gates are blocked. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 36 pass, 19 fail, 6 unknown. No go-live proposal is approved.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Four existing legal tasks remain open; none are closed because the snapshot does not evidence completion. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering Woot rights, SearchWoot data flow/retention, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling to the existing checklist. Do not request duplicate telemetry, change production, enable tracking, send outreach, or clear the private gate.

Concrete decision required: confirm SearchWoot remains private and rights outreach remains unsent pending human counsel review and completion of technical gates. This is a risk triage disposition, not legal advice or certification.

For the existing SearchWoot evidence workstream, produce a read-only table from repository and deployed configuration showing alert rules, access/session identifiers, sync results, Slack/email delivery, retention, deletion, correction, access, and unsubscribe behavior. This is the smallest next action for the open data-flow task; do not expand notifications or change configuration.

Measurement remains a launch blocker but not a blocker to ordinary reversible growth. Available Amazon evidence is 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21; commission is aggregate under tracking ID other and cannot support site revenue, ROI, margin, or causal-lift claims. Next action: retain the attribution boundary and reconcile only when site/content identifiers and direct costs are available.
